title: Approved playbook and reusable tool registry
scope: Version tools/playbooks with approval status, allowed operations and provenance requirements

acceptance.text: Version tools/playbooks with approval status, allowed operations and provenance requirements
Reject unapproved tool/workflow versions and replay a known approved version
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR

verification: Reject unapproved tool/workflow versions and replay a known approved version

evidence.text: ai/workflows/playbook_registry.py + playbook_registry.synthetic.json (ADR-017) version 5 tools and 4 playbooks (refund_lanes, imported_services, related_party, work_arrangement; policy_gap_gate) with status approved/proposed/retired, synthetic supervisor approver distinct from proposer, allowed_operations from a fixed allowlist (apply_approved_action requires human_checkpoint), provenance requirements (case_scoped, advisory_only, evidence_citations, deterministic, human_checkpoint), name@version tool references and a line-ending-normalised SHA-256 of the exact source files. Builders come from a fixed in-code table so registry data cannot load code; run_playbook stamps each finding with name/version/digest/approver/registry version.

tests/ai/test_playbook_registry.py (11 tests, 27 subtests): every shipped approved digest matches current source; 10 load-time policy violations refused; unregistered/proposed/retired versions rejected (version_not_registered/version_proposed/version_retired); an edited source file rejects its tool and playbook (source_digest_mismatch) while unrelated playbooks stay approved; unapproved tool blocks its playbook; tampered digest rejected; CRLF==LF digest. Known approved versions of refund_lanes (SYN-001), imported_services (SYN-004) and related_party (SYN-002) replay to replay_matched with identical output digests; changed input or digest rejected on replay; changed case evidence reported replay_diverged; checkpointed work_arrangement runs through the registry. .venv-ai pytest tests/ai: 157 passed; ruff/mypy (146 files) pass.
